December 22, 2025 Criminal Writ Petition No. 898/2023 Heard.

2]  Vide order dated 10/12/2025, respondent no.3 was directed to deposit an amount of Rs.1,00,000/- so that, and if required, same could be awarded to the petitioners, as compensation, if it is found that they have been falsely implicated in the present case.
3] The Counsel for respondent no.3 submits that she has e-filed written submissions saying that respondent no.3 is not in a position to deposit the amount.
4] The submissions are not before us.
We will, accordingly, consider the same in due course.

5] In the meantime, the Assistant Commissioner of Police, Jaripatka Division, Nagpur, shall go through the judgment of The High Court of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur in the case of Umang Singhar s/o Mr. Dayaram Singhar Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh and Another [M.CR.C. No.
59600/2022 decided on 21/9/2023], and examine whether ingredients of Section 377 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC), will be made out against the husband.
